gwen.partners: Heads-up 1: we need a short playbook for Gaudi+MI300 that combines embargo windows, fallback routing, and SI handoff. Keep it customer-facing where possible.

eli-hw: I can own HW checklist: signed firmware hash, kernel tag, lab power logs. Vendor note: Habana may ship microcode late-June.

rachael-prod: Marketplace needs: tile JSON, pricing slug, supported shapes, and a "fallback guidance" paragraph. Legal wants embargo start/end dates.

noah-devex: I'll prepare quickstart + sample IaC for attaching devices, plus CI smoke: `ci/marketplace/gaudi-mi300/smoke`. Quick smoke example:
```
./smoke --model llama2-7b --seq 1024 --bs 1 --p50 140
```

maya-oncall: Ops play: propose rule `if cap(mi300_region) < 0.15 => route to [h200,b200] else if p50_delta>0.2 => route gaudi_compat_degraded`. Need SRE signoff.

gwen.partners: Owners: Eli->HW, Rachael->marketplace+embargo, Noah->devex+CI, Maya->ops playbook, Gwen->press + comms. Draft sheet by Tue EOD, full artifacts by Fri.

eli-hw: I'll DM vendor contacts after this thread and add freeze dates.

rachael-prod: I'll draft tile YAML and include fallback paragraph.

noah-devex: PR for quickstart and CI by Wed.

maya-oncall: Filing INFRA-5010 for `lab-image: power-profile-v4`.

system-bot: Reminder set: Meeting Tue 09:30 "Gaudi/MI300 readiness review" (15m).
